prompt: I need a monthly fuel summary report: for each vehicle, broken down by month, total liters, total amount, and average price per liter. It should accept from/to date params (defaulting to a wide range) and be served at GET /api/reports/fuel-summary. Add a getFuelSummary() service function too. Do the grouping in SQL with GROUP BY — the existing /api/reports/fuel-consumption endpoint pulls every row into JS and computes there, which is slow, so don't copy that approach.
assertions: Route file created at src/app/api/reports/fuel-summary/route.js exporting a GET handler
Handler calls requireAuth, wraps logic in try/catch ending with handleError, returns ok(...)
Aggregation done in SQL with GROUP BY (no JS reduce/forEach over fetched rows)
Groups by vehicle and month (TO_CHAR/DATE_TRUNC on fuel_date), returning vehicle plate_number/vehicle_name
Returns total liters (SUM), total amount (SUM), and average price per liter (AVG(price_per_liter) or SUM(amount)/NULLIF(SUM(liters),0))
from/to params are parameterized with $1/$2 placeholders and default to a wide range
getFuelSummary() added to src/services/fuel.service.js using apiFetch + buildQuery
